title: Navigate model runs and valid times
checked_criteria: - [x] Default to the newest usable run and its first available valid time. Changing runs starts at that run's first available time.
- [x] Keep run and publication revision fixed during time navigation; distinguish reference time from valid time and show gaps honestly.
- [x] Selecting an unavailable time clears both overlay and point value without selecting a nearby time or another run.
- [x] Changing run/time clears old point results; delayed responses for prior selections are discarded.
- [x] Browser tests use clearly marked overlapping-run/missing-time fixtures and real APIs, including controlled response races, and compare visible behavior to the reviewed interaction prototype.

- [x] Exercise delayed numeric tile fetch, decode and GPU upload races during run/time changes. Clear prior overlay/textures on missing-time selection and reject previous-selection completions; caches include revision/time/encoding identity. Do not interpolate across missing times, runs or revisions.
